purpose: Ornamental plants maintained at home in pots, hanging baskets, or as indoor specimens. Source categories are retained; inclusion is not a claim of suitability for every home or climate.

excluded_ids.corpse-flower: Source describes a massive, rarely flowering specimen; outside the household ornamental focus.
excluded_ids.saguaro: Source describes a giant desert cactus growing up to 12 metres; outside the household ornamental focus.
excluded_ids.welwitschia: Source describes an unusual long-lived Namib Desert specimen; outside the household ornamental focus.
